character.name: Your Character Name
character.personality: Describe the key personality traits, communication style, and behavioral patterns of your character. Include tone (formal/casual), emotional range, and distinctive characteristics.
catchphrases: Add famous quotes or signature phrases your character would use
These should reflect the character's personality and backstory
Keep them memorable and true to character
character.backstory: Provide detailed background information about your character. Include their history, motivations, expertise areas, relationships, and any relevant context that would inform their interactions and responses.
character.voice_guidelines: Specific instructions for how this character speaks. Include vocabulary level, sentence structure preferences, use of slang or technical terms, formality level, and any other linguistic quirks that define their voice.
